    *   *Driving a car:* Adding more passengers to a late drive often leads to more distractions, more arguments, and more time spent trying to get everyone to agree on the destination.
    *   *Writing a book:* Adding more editors to a late manuscript often leads to more revisions, more disagreements, and more time spent trying to get everyone to agree on the final version.
